en: Only sometimes I find a conflict between family people.
zh: 仅在有些时候，我发现家庭成员之间有冲突

en: Your priority should be sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga, sahaja yoga.
zh: 你的首要任务应该是霎哈嘉瑜伽，霎哈嘉瑜伽，霎哈嘉瑜伽。

en: Say a husband may not be equally interested in sahaja yoga and the wife is pulled down.
zh: 比如说丈夫可能对霎哈嘉瑜伽并没有那么有兴趣，那么妻子就会被拉下来

en: She should show that her interest is sahaja yoga nothing else and he will come.
zh: 她应该表明她的兴趣只在霎哈嘉瑜伽，别无其他，他就会加入（或：他就会来）。

en: She should not give way to him.
zh: 她不应该让步，她不应该向他让步

en: And if he is so that he wants to get into sahaja yoga and she objects.
zh: 而如果是他想要进入霎哈嘉瑜伽，她却反对

en: She has no business to do that under any divine law she has no business to do that.
zh: 她没有权利这么做，在任何神圣的律法之下，她都没有权利这么做

en: If she tries that, husband need not listen to her at all he should go full ahead.
zh: 如果她试图那样做，丈夫根本不必理会她，而应勇往直前。

en: Because ultimately he is an important part of sahaja yoga.
zh: 因为最终他是霎哈嘉瑜伽的一个重要部分

en: And he should not in any way make the importance less.
zh: 他不应该以任何方式降低其重要性

en: So she should go ahead with what she wants.
zh: 所以她应该继续做她想做的事

en: If he is a sahaja yogi he should not bother about anything.
zh: 如果他是一个霎哈嘉瑜伽士，他不应该为任何事烦恼

en: His family will be blessed, everybody will be blessed, if he is there.
zh: 如果他在那里，他的家庭会得到祝福，所有人都会得到祝福

en: So any excuses, that takes you away from sahaja yoga are not helpful to the family.
zh: 因此，任何将你带离霎哈嘉瑜伽的借口，都对家庭没有帮助。

en: Because if the deities are angry your family will be harmed.
zh: 因为如果神祇生气了，你的家庭就会受到伤害

en: If say, a woman is a sahaja-yogini and her family people object to it they will be harmed and she will be harmed as well.
zh: 如果说，一个女性是一位霎哈嘉瑜伽士，而她的家人反对霎哈嘉瑜伽，她的家人就会受到伤害，而她也会受到伤害

en: But if she is in sahaja yoga all the family will be saved.
zh: 但是如果她在霎哈嘉瑜伽之中，那么整个家庭都会得到拯救

en: So, you are doing a greater, you are doing a greater service to your family by becoming a sahaja yogi and a true sahaja yogi and a dedicated and devoted [sahaja yogi].
zh: 所以，你正在做一件更伟大的事，你正在为你的家庭做出更大的贡献，通过成为一名霎哈嘉瑜伽士，一名真正的霎哈嘉瑜伽士，以及一位虔诚奉献的[霎哈嘉瑜伽士]。

en: But no individualistic efforts, no individualistic attitude is helpful to Me or to sahaja yoga, is very detrimental under any name under any banner un[der any pretext].
zh: 但是，任何个人主义的努力或个人主义的态度，对我或霎哈嘉瑜伽都无益，以任何名义、任何旗帜、任何借口[行事]都是非常有害的。

en: Try to find out ways and methods of becoming one with others.
zh: 尝试找出与他人融为一体的方式和方法

en: If you want to find out faults with others there can be any, I mean I should not be here.
zh: 如果你想找别人的茬，那可以有无数种理由，我的意思是我不应该在这里。

en: I can say that.
zh: 我可以这么说

en: Then I should not be on this earth.
zh: 那么我也不应该在这个地球上

en: I could have said that.
zh: 我本可以这么说

en: But I see that spirit in you, and I see that beauty in you.
zh: 但是我看到了你内在的灵，我看到了你内在的美丽

en: I don’t see other things.
zh: 我看不到其他东西

en: If I had not seen that spirit I would not have worked like this.
zh: 如果我不曾看到灵，我就不会像这样工作
